title: KnowBias: Mitigating Social Bias in LLMs via Know-Bias Neuron Enhancement
benchmark_measurement: The paper measures stereotypical biases associated with religion as a demographic category. The evaluation uses existing social bias benchmarks (BBQ, CrowS-Pairs, StereoSet) to quantify the extent of stereotypical associations in language models and assesses the effectiveness of the proposed 'KnowBias' method in mitigating them.
findings: The proposed 'KnowBias' method effectively and consistently reduces social biases related to religion across multiple LLMs and benchmarks. The method achieved one of the top ranks for debiasing performance on the religion dimension, demonstrating its ability to mitigate stereotypes while largely preserving the models' general reasoning capabilities.
